prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent 2D foliage sprite for Safety Last, a hand-painted overhead survival game. Input images: first image is the existing camp terrain STYLE reference; second is current in-game artwork STYLE and perspective reference only. Do not redraw either reference. Match their warm earthy olive/ochre palette, broad readable painterly contours and charming detailed game art. Camera: high three-quarter view looking down 60 degrees, consistent with the references. Soft upper-left daylight. Genuine transparent background with alpha, no floor, no soil disc, no ground shadow, no backdrop. Exactly ONE isolated rooted clump centered, whole silhouette including every leaf tip inside the canvas with generous clear margins. The root/crown converges near lower center; the plant will bend above that fixed root in game. No labels, text, people, bonfire, props, rocks, pot, disconnected leaves or other objects. Keep leaf shapes bold and readable at runtime 80–130 pixels wide.
Primary request: a tall waist-high leafy olive woodland shrub, 4 connected soft woody stems with about 25 broad rounded spoon-shaped leaves, upright but loosely asymmetric, slightly taller than wide, three visible levels of foliage. Muted moss and olive green with warm yellow-green highlights and darker undersides; branch/root convergence visible near bottom-center at around 88% of height. Not a tree, no bulky trunk, no flowers.
